article.headline: Trio helps West Virginia hold off Auburn 76-70 to reach semifinals of Players Era 8
article.description: — Brenen Lorient finished with 19 points, and Miles Sadler and Finley Bizjack both scored 18 to help West Virginia fend off Auburn 76-70 on Tuesday in the nightcap of the Players Era 8 at Michelob ULTRA Arena.

article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Brenen Lorient finished with 19 points, and Miles Sadler and Finley Bizjack both scored 18 to help West Virginia fend off Auburn 76-70 on Tuesday in the nightcap of the Players Era 8 at Michelob ULTRA Arena. West Virginia (4-0) advances to play 11th-ranked Kansas in a Wednesday semifinal between Big 12 Conference foes. Auburn will play UNLV on Wednesday in the consolation round. The Jayhawks beat the Rebels 102-77 prior to the Mountaineers and Tigers tipping off. Bizjack made three free throws to give the Mountaineers their largest lead at 52-34 with 13:25 left to play. Tahaad Pettiford hit a 3-pointer and Narcisse Ngoy added a dunk to cut it to 60-59 at the end of a 25-8 run with 5:18 remaining. But West Virginia never gave up the lead and Lorient hit a 3-pointer and two free throws as the Mountaineers outscored the Tigers 10-5 down the stretch. Lorient made 7 of 8 shots — 3 for 3 on 3-pointers — and both of his free throws, adding three steals. Sadler had six assists and Bizjack grabbed five rebounds. Pettiford scored 15 of his 21 points in the second half for Auburn and Caleb Williams scored 13 off the bench. The Tigers took their biggest lead early at 9-3, but Lorient scored seven unanswered points and West Virginia moved in front 27-22 and never trailed again, leading 36-31 at halftime. Bizjack scored the final seven points in a 9-0 run to begin the second half to help the Mountaineers build their 18-point lead. Auburn outshot West Virginia 48%-45%, but the Mountaineers made 7 of 22 from distance and 19 of 23 at the foul line, while the Tigers made 5 of 23 from distance and 13 of 22 at the line. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here Up next SE Louisiana plays at Kennesaw State on Friday in a campus game of the Cancun Challenge. Texas A&M plays at TCU on Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
